correctness.rationale: For Split_d(P^n), the degree-d! finite multiplication map (P^n)^d -> Split_d has pullback hyperplane sum H_i; integration gives deg=(nd)!/[d!(n!)^d]. Unique linear factorization yields a continuous bijection Sym^d(P^n)->Split, hence compact-to-Hausdorff homeomorphism of complex analytic spaces; Macdonald symmetric-power Euler series yields chi=binom(n+d,d). For n,d>=2, exact ratios R(n,d+1)/R(n,d)=prod_{j=1}^n(nd+j)/[n!(n+d+1)]>1 and R(n+1,d)/R(n,d)=prod_{j=1}^d(nd+j)/[(n+1)^(d-1)(n+d+1)]>1. Boundary n=1 or d=1 has degree1<chi; R(2,2)=1/2,R(3,2)=1,R(2,3)=3/2 prove unique equality (n,d)=(3,2), both10. Independently evaluated all n,d<=20 exactly, equal only (3,2), and symbolic monotonic proof supplies all parameters.
